Workplace dust and welding fumes can present significant occupational health risks — and managing that exposure isn't optional. Employers must manage exposure risks in accordance with applicable work health and safety legislation and exposure standards. Effective local exhaust ventilation, appropriate filtration and ongoing maintenance all contribute to a broader workplace risk-control strategy. Burwell Environmental Division can help you review your extraction requirements against your obligations. #WorkplaceHealthAndSafety #ExposureStandards #WHSCompliance #BurwellEnvironmental #AirborneContaminants
